summary: Videos is now a built-in Veyra feature with a mobile-friendly library and an in-app media player.
instructions: Tap Videos in the chat navigation, open a course folder, then choose a video. The player provides native playback, seeking and full-screen controls, plus Previous and Next links within the folder. On your iPhone use the same Veyra address and sign-in as chat; no separate port is needed. Lessons are sorted in numerical order. The library uses the existing course folder in Downloads and hides non-media files. Automated tests passed for player rendering, sorting, safe filenames, navigation, authentication, streaming byte ranges, HEAD requests and shared page updates, alongside all 32 web-chat tests. Actual iPhone playback has not been verified and depends on browser codec support; no transcoding is provided. No firewall or separate port 8090 server settings were changed.
